boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Kansas State University
boards.description: Ten currently listed, under-21-safe food stops in Manhattan with late operating hours verified from direct business or district sources.

cards.title: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill
cards.subtitle: 325 East Poyntz Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the Poyntz Avenue location for a late meal; check the official ordering page before leaving because daily hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A Poyntz Avenue restaurant listed through midnight most nights and until 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Manhattan location lists hours of 11 AM–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 AM–2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill — Manhattan, KS
cards.access_notes: Official listed hours: Sun–Thu 11 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 11 AM–2 AM. Confirm holiday hours before visiting.

cards.title: Fat Shack
cards.subtitle: 1131 Moro St, Manhattan
cards.notes: Head to the Moro Street storefront when you need a food option after most evening service ends; confirm service availability first.
cards.short_summary: A Moro Street sandwich-and-dessert stop with listed service to 1 AM or 3 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Fat Shack’s Manhattan menu lists 1131 Moro St and hours of 11 AM–1 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 11 AM–3 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official menu lists Sun–Wed 11 AM–1 AM and Thu–Sat 11 AM–3 AM. Check for changes before going.

cards.title: D.P. Dough
cards.subtitle: 1120b Moro Street, Manhattan
cards.notes: Choose this Moro Street calzone shop for a very late carryout or delivery option; verify the day’s operations before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A calzone restaurant in Aggieville with a listed 4 AM close every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aggieville district listing gives D.P. Dough’s address as 1120b Moro Street and lists hours of 4 PM–4 AM Monday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 4 PM–4 AM daily. Verify hours and ordering availability before heading out.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Westport Road
cards.subtitle: 1155 Westport Road, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the latest listed access; dine-in closes earlier, so plan for takeout when arriving later in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A Westport Road drive-through that the official locator lists until 2 AM daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through hours of 7 AM–2 AM every day at 1155 Westport Road.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed 7 AM–2 AM daily; official page lists Thursday dine-in only through 10 PM. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on East Poyntz
cards.subtitle: 329 East Poyntz Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the East Poyntz dining room or drive-through for a later food stop; check current service before starting the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Poyntz Avenue chicken-finger restaurant listed until midnight or 2 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists both dine-in and drive-through at 329 East Poyntz Ave until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 2 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: Sun–Thu 10 AM–12 AM; Fri–Sat 10 AM–2 AM for dine-in and drive-through. Verify exceptions.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Anderson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2615 Anderson Avenue, Manhattan
cards.notes: Order ahead for carryout or delivery from Anderson Avenue; the official page separates delivery and carryout closing times.
cards.short_summary: An Anderson Avenue pizza location with midnight service most days and later Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists delivery until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 AM Friday–Saturday; carryout is listed until 11:40 PM or 12:40 AM.
cards.access_notes: Delivery: midnight Sun–Thu, 1 AM Fri–Sat; carryout: 11:40 PM Sun–Thu, 12:40 AM Fri–Sat. Confirm availability.

cards.title: Culver's on McCall Road
cards.subtitle: 529 McCall Rd, Manhattan
cards.notes: Make this a late-evening stop for dine-in or drive-through; the official restaurant page lists the same midnight close every day.
cards.short_summary: A McCall Road restaurant listed open to midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s official Manhattan location lists lobby, dine-in, and drive-through hours of 10 AM–midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Lobby, dine-in, and drive-through are listed 10 AM–12 AM daily; Curdside ends at 11:45 PM. Check updates before visiting.

cards.title: Wendy's on Good Food Place
cards.subtitle: 100 Good Food Place, Manhattan
cards.notes: Use the restaurant or drive-through for a later takeout stop; official hours list midnight daily but note that holidays may vary.
cards.short_summary: A Good Food Place restaurant and drive-through listed through midnight every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 7:30 AM–midnight Monday through Sunday at 100 Good Food Place.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through are listed 7:30 AM–12 AM daily; the official page notes holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Anderson Avenue
cards.subtitle: 2707 Anderson Ave, Manhattan
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order before heading over; the official locator lists both store and delivery service through 11 PM daily.
cards.short_summary: An Anderson Avenue sandwich shop with official hours to 11 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s official page lists the 2707 Anderson Ave location and its delivery hours as 10 AM–11 PM every day.
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours are listed 10 AM–11 PM daily. Verify delivery-area eligibility and current hours before ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Hostetler Drive
cards.subtitle: 1005 Hostetler Drive, Manhattan
cards.notes: Plan carryout or delivery from Hostetler Drive for a later pizza option, especially on Friday or Saturday when the official page lists midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Hostetler Drive pizza restaurant listed through midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout hours at 1005 Hostetler Drive until midnight on Friday and Saturday and until 11 PM other days.
cards.access_notes: Official listed delivery and carryout hours: 10:30 AM–11 PM Sun–Thu; through 12 AM Fri–Sat. Confirm before visiting.
